opentargets.name: lupus nephritis
opentargets.description: Glomerulonephritis in the context of systemic lupus erythematosus.

opentargets.name: autosomal systemic lupus erythematosus type 16
opentargets.description: An instance of systemic lupus erythematosus (disease) that is caused by mutations in DNASE1L3.

opentargets.name: systemic lupus erythematosus
opentargets.description: An autoimmune multi-organ disease typically associated with vasculopathy and autoantibody production. Most patients have antinuclear antibodies (ANA). The presence of anti-dsDNA or anti-Smith antibodies are highly-specific.

opentargets.name: systemic lupus erythematosus 18
opentargets.description: Any systemic lupus erythematosus in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the PLD4 gene.

opentargets.name: Acute tubulointerstitial nephritis
opentargets.description: Acute inflammation of the kidney affecting the interstitium of the kidneys surrounding the tubules.
